name: Campaign claim evidence register
summary: An account lead gets a register that pairs each draft campaign claim with the evidence the client supplied, its source date, proposed qualified wording and the approvals still missing. Unsupported or stale claims are blocked; only approved wording is released.

sources.title: Its own published map of the work of pairing a campaign's draft claims with the client's supplied evidence, and its own method for dating, scoping, qualifying and approving each claim.
